responsibility: Implements the rs6000 machine-description patterns for paired-single floating-point vector operations. It defines the RTL insns and expanders for V2SF paired arithmetic, fused multiply-add/subtract forms, merge/extract-style operations, reciprocal/divide/sqrt, comparisons and conditional selection, reductions, vector initialization, and misaligned moves, using TARGET_PAIRED_FLOAT and helper routines such as paired_expand_vector_init, paired_expand_vector_move, and paired_emit_vector_cond_expr to lower generic vector RTL and paired builtins into PowerPC ps_* instructions.
same_name_distinction: This is the paired-single machine-description file, defining RTL insns and expanders for ps_* operations and helper-driven lowering. Unlike paired.h, it does not provide the user-facing intrinsic header API.
